t: You're on Haymarket, a street in St James's in Westminster, running from Piccadilly Circus in the north down to Pall Mall. Along it are the Theatre Royal, His Majesty's Theatre, New Zealand House, a cinema complex and restaurants. The street has some literary history. The actress, playwright and novelist Charlotte Charke died here; she was the daughter of Colley Cibber, and she performed for a time as Charles Brown. Louisa Bain, who kept a diary every day from 1857 to 1883, lived here with her husband James, a London bookseller.
